questions.question: What is Node.js, and when is it a good choice?
questions.questionMarathi: Node.js म्हणजे काय आणि तो कधी वापरणे योग्य असते?
questions.answer: Node.js is a JavaScript runtime built on the V8 engine. Its event-driven, non-blocking I/O model is effective for APIs, streaming, and applications with many concurrent network operations. CPU-heavy work may need worker threads or separate services so it does not block the event loop.
questions.answerMarathi: Node.js हा V8 engine वर आधारित JavaScript runtime आहे. Event-driven आणि non-blocking I/O मुळे APIs, streaming आणि अनेक concurrent network operations असलेल्या applications साठी तो प्रभावी आहे. CPU-intensive कामांसाठी worker threads किंवा स्वतंत्र services वापरणे योग्य असते, जेणेकरून event loop block होणार नाही.
questions.codeExplanation: The server handles requests asynchronously and can continue accepting other work while I/O is pending.
questions.codeExplanationMarathi: I/O पूर्ण होण्याची वाट पाहताना server इतर काम स्वीकारू शकतो; requests asynchronous पद्धतीने हाताळल्या जातात.

questions.question: How does the Node.js event loop support non-blocking I/O?
questions.questionMarathi: Node.js event loop non-blocking I/O ला कशी मदत करतो?
questions.answer: JavaScript callbacks run on the event loop thread. Node delegates many I/O operations to the operating system or its worker pool, then queues their callbacks when they complete. Long synchronous or CPU-heavy work still blocks that thread and delays other callbacks.
questions.answerMarathi: JavaScript callbacks event loop thread वर चालतात. अनेक I/O operations Node operating system किंवा worker pool कडे सोपवतो आणि operation पूर्ण झाल्यावर callback queue करतो. लांब synchronous किंवा CPU-intensive काम मात्र तो thread block करून इतर callbacks ला उशीर लावते.
questions.codeExplanation: The timer callback runs after the current synchronous stack completes, even with a zero-millisecond delay.
questions.codeExplanationMarathi: शून्य millisecond delay असला तरी सध्याचा synchronous stack पूर्ण झाल्यानंतर timer callback चालतो.

questions.question: What is the difference between CommonJS and ECMAScript modules in Node.js?
questions.questionMarathi: Node.js मधील CommonJS आणि ECMAScript modules मध्ये काय फरक आहे?
questions.answer: CommonJS uses require() and module.exports and is traditionally loaded synchronously. ECMAScript modules use import and export, support static analysis and top-level await, and are enabled with .mjs files or package configuration such as "type": "module".
questions.answerMarathi: CommonJS मध्ये require() आणि module.exports वापरतात आणि त्याची loading पारंपरिकरित्या synchronous असते. ECMAScript modules मध्ये import आणि export वापरतात; ते static analysis आणि top-level await समर्थित करतात. .mjs extension किंवा package मधील "type": "module" वापरून ते enable करता येतात.
questions.codeExplanation: Use the module syntax configured for the project and avoid mixing module systems without a clear interoperability plan.
questions.codeExplanationMarathi: Project मध्ये configure केलेली module syntax वापरा आणि स्पष्ट interoperability योजना नसताना module systems मिसळू नका.

questions.question: How should errors be handled in an async Node.js request handler?
questions.questionMarathi: Async Node.js request handler मध्ये errors कसे हाताळावेत?
questions.answer: Use try/catch around awaited operations, log useful server-side context, and translate known failures into appropriate HTTP responses. Pass unexpected errors to centralized middleware or an error boundary; do not expose stack traces or sensitive details to clients.
questions.answerMarathi: await केलेल्या operations भोवती try/catch वापरा, server-side context सह log करा आणि ओळखलेल्या failures साठी योग्य HTTP response द्या. अनपेक्षित errors centralized middleware कडे पाठवा; stack traces किंवा संवेदनशील माहिती client ला देऊ नका.
questions.codeExplanation: Forwarding the error lets shared middleware apply consistent logging and response handling.
questions.codeExplanationMarathi: Error पुढे पाठवल्याने shared middleware मध्ये logging आणि response handling सुसंगत राहते.

questions.question: How can you handle CPU-intensive work without blocking a Node.js server?
questions.questionMarathi: Node.js server block न करता CPU-intensive काम कसे हाताळाल?
questions.answer: Move CPU-heavy tasks to worker threads, a job queue, or a separate service. Worker threads are useful for parallel JavaScript computation; queues help with durable, retryable background work. Keep request handlers responsive and limit concurrency according to available resources.
questions.answerMarathi: CPU-intensive tasks worker threads, job queue किंवा स्वतंत्र service मध्ये हलवा. Parallel JavaScript computation साठी worker threads उपयुक्त आहेत; टिकाऊ आणि retry करता येणाऱ्या background कामांसाठी queues मदत करतात. Request handlers responsive ठेवा आणि उपलब्ध resources नुसार concurrency मर्यादित ठेवा.
questions.codeExplanation: The worker performs CPU-bound work outside the main event loop thread.
questions.codeExplanationMarathi: Worker CPU-bound काम मुख्य event loop thread च्या बाहेर करतो.
